# `constant-comptime-condition`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an explicitly comptime condition that is the literal `true` or `false`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

One branch is permanently inactive in the current source and can hide obsolete
configuration code.

## When it fires

It is useful after feature or target logic has been simplified to a constant.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f() u32 {
    if (comptime true) return 1;
    return 2;
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#comptime>
